title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Policy Recommendation panel
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, default state, product licensing requirement and role-group controls are supported. Microsoft does not establish that the panel introduces no new detection; that assertion should be narrowed. The analytics path stops before its switch, a billing statement needs its source cited, and the action rating should reflect the approaching automatic rollout.
